SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(return_type_normalized, ''), '미분류') AS refund_reason,
  COUNT(*) AS refund_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT shopify_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  SUM(refund_amount_usd) AS successful_refund_amount_usd,
  SUM(refund_amount_krw) AS recorded_refund_amount_krw,
  COUNTIF(refund_amount_krw IS NULL) AS refunds_without_krw
FROM `skin1004-319714.cs_dashboard.overseas_cs_refunds`
WHERE DATE(refund_created_at, 'Asia/Seoul') BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY refund_reason
ORDER BY refund_records DESC
LIMIT 1000
